newsitem.title: UK: Prudential raises some policy bonuses.
newsitem.headline: Prudential raises some policy bonuses.

text.p: British insurance group Prudential Plc said on Wednesday it would add 1.865 billion stg of bonuses to its customers' policies this year.
Prudential, which calls itself Britain's largest life insurer, said bonus rates on personal pension products had been raised to 9.75 percent from 9.5 percent.
Bonus rates on savings products remained stable at 8.25 percent for 1997, the insurer said in a statement.
Annual reversionary bonuses for some policies have been slightly reduced because of continued low inflation, Prudential said.
Prudential said personal pensions products accounted for around half of current sales. Savings products accounted for about three quarters of the remaining sales. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 4017
